name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
tagline: Muthoot Pappachan-group NBFC-MFI trading near its IPO price, with a now well-confirmed post-downcycle turn — FY27 guidance raised to 18-20% AUM growth and ~18% ROE, rating upgraded to AA-, gold co-lending live. A solid 2-4x recovery-compounder, not a 10x.
business_overview: Rural-focused microfinance lender (JLG loans, plus growing Individual Loans / Micro-LAP, MSME and a new gold-loan referral/co-lending line with parent Muthoot Fincorp). Promoter: Muthoot Pappachan group (~55.5%). CEO Sadaf Sayeed. IPO Dec-2023; stock fell to roughly half the issue price during the FY25 MFI-sector stress (Karnataka MFI ordinance, industry-wide over-leverage and asset-quality deterioration) and has since recovered toward the issue price.

fundamentals_narrative: Trailing ROE (~5% on a 3-yr basis) reflects the FY25 cycle trough, not the through-cycle earning power. The turn is now well-confirmed rather than nascent: FY26 PAT swung to +Rs 170 Cr from a -Rs 222 Cr loss, and Q1 FY27 delivered a broad-based beat — disbursements +49% YoY (record Q1), AUM +18% YoY, PPOP +43% YoY, credit cost down to 2.6%, collection efficiency ~98% and rising, cost of funds falling to 10.14% with a fresh AA-/Stable rating upgrade. Crucially, management RAISED FY27 guidance at Q1 (AUM growth to 18-20%, RoA to as high as 3.3%, implied ROE ~18%) rather than merely reaffirming it, and 'Vision 3030' targets Rs 30,000 Cr AUM (~20-21% CAGR) with non-JLG products going from 17% to 47% of the book by 2030. Gold-loan co-lending with parent Muthoot Fincorp has commenced (Rs 193 Cr in Q1). The model remains an inherently leveraged, socially/politically sensitive one — a fresh state ordinance or local disruption can re-trough credit cost quickly — and the public track record is under two years.
technical_read: Not pulled. Stock recovered ~+32% over one year to near the Dec-2023 IPO price.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent ~16 of ~39 posts (topic 138042), 2024–Aug 2026. Arc from downcycle worry (Karnataka ordinance, Karnataka ~10% of book, expected weak quarters) to recovery: closed underperforming branches, asset quality improving, guidance upgraded to 20%, 'Vision 3030' launched, clean Q1 FY27. Some caution that the core JLG book de-grew QoQ as management stays deliberately cautious on MFI growth.

verdict_headline: Well-confirmed post-downcycle turn with raised guidance and a rating upgrade — a solid 2-4x recovery-compounder at Medium-High conviction, but not a 10x-in-2-3-years
verdict_reasoning: The operating inflection is now confirmed in reported numbers (FY26 turnaround + a broad-based Q1 FY27 beat) and de-risked by a guidance raise (not just a reaffirmation) and an AA-/Stable rating upgrade — supports Medium-High conviction

Thesis-fit moved 10x-in-2-3-years -> neither on the arithmetic: 10x from ~Rs 3,600 Cr implies ~Rs 36,000 Cr, beyond even Vision 3030's Rs 30,000 Cr AUM aspiration for 2030. The realistic prize is a 2-4x move as ROE normalises toward ~16-18% and the multiple re-rates off trough
MFI political/regulatory tail risk, an early guidance raise, an intra-group gold co-lending RPT, and a sub-two-year public track record keep conviction short of High
revisit_after_30d retained — track JLG book growth resuming, credit cost toward ~2%, and gold co-lending economics

four_box.note: Bank pullback from MFI lending is 'real but incremental, not transformational' per verdict_reasoning — tailwind weak; explicit arithmetic (Vision 3030 caps AUM at ~2.1x by 2030) rules out tam; gold co-lending/MSME diversification reduces cyclicality but is an intra-group RPT arrangement, not a strong moat — weak; trades near IPO price at trough ROE with a guidance raise and rating upgrade — real valuation upside, yes.

track_record.note: NBFC-MFI -- profitability leg on ROE. Of the years with verifiable ROE on screener (FY24-FY26), only FY24 (+14% revenue / ROE 20%) cleared both bars; FY25 was a sector-downcycle loss year (ROE -8%), and FY26 recovery ROE was only ~6%. Pre-FY24 ROE not captured this pass. Asset quality is improving (GNPA 3.70%, credit cost 2.6% falling, CE ~98%, AA- upgrade) and FY27 guided ROE ~18% is prospective.
